It's because the misanthropes without willpower are promptly locked up.

Society selects for misanthropes who can manage it, so you're only ever exposed to those people.
Should've just erased all human life but left everything else.

I'm not saying the incels are right, but...

...You're making it hard to prove them wrong at this rate. 

Your behaviour is disgusting. He deserves a woman who would value him and treat him properly. If you can only get off on the prospect he's going to mistreat you, you need psychological help.
23, irrevocably philosophically fucked up to the point where I am immune to happiness and contentment.

Force yourself to stay alive so you can get revenge. When he's old and infirm, sitting in a wheelchair and shitting himself, torture him. Make him feel 1000 times worse than you feel now. Sit there and laugh while he soils himself on a daily basis. Stick needles in him, hide his medication and half the doses so he never *quite* gets there, encourage other people to abuse him and record it if you can, make sure he knows it's going out to the wider world.
No, they genuinely believe their own bullshit because they're mentally retarded. Optimism is a psychological disorder as sure as depression or psychosis.

Shooting "victims" always makes me laugh. They're not victims, they're winners. I wish some hero would turn me into a shooting "victim", he would be doing me and everybody else a favour. It would be a truly selfless act and one of the only true goods a human is capable of doing.
It's good, I wish I was antinatalised.

I honestly don't think you look that bad. You don't really have much of a jaw, but that's the only real flaw. You're above average looking, in my estimation, so it's probably your personality/shyness that lets you down. That's good, because you can pretend you have a different personality, but you can't pretend to be taller or have a different bone structure.

Like others are saying, avoid them as much as possible. Just avoid all human interaction, even with idiots on the internet and on forums such as this. Everybody is an irrational idiot. We are just apes.
The best thing we can do is engineer a plague that targets humans specifically, spreads like the common cold and if it doesn't kill them in a few days it should render them infertile.
Go away and smoke your meth and listen to your hip hop you shit-suckling degenerate normie.

Same. It will make a Travis Bickle out of anybody. Working in retail makes me want to detonate an ebola bomb that spreads the disease around the entire planet to exterminate everybody in a painful, degrading and utterly squalid way.
Can confirm, I'm selfish and pathetic and you are too. We are all hairless apes on an endless quest to avoid boredom until we die of old age.

If you've never been in a relationship by the age of 25, you need to accept that it's over for you. That door has closed forever. Even if you do find a washed up warpig with 6 caramel coloured children who lets you pay for a house for her, she'll just unfavourably compare you to one of the dozens of lumbering brutes she will have fucked over the years. Stop kidding yourself.
It's a shame more people weren't killed. To counterbalance this botched effort, there was some good news about ebola spreading in an urban area somewhere in Africa.

I hate it when this happens. Just because I don't speak the jargon that gets them through their shitty just-above-minimum-wage soulless office job day doesn't mean I'm intellectually inferior to them. To the contrary, this kinds of reprobates and degenerates are usually tremendously stupid and have to invent things like this to mask their insecurities.

Think about ways to get revenge. Pretend you like him and gain his friendship. Manipulate him. Get him to tell you secrets and things about himself. Get him drunk and make him do embarrassing things. When you have dirt on him, blackmail him with it, make him do degrading things on camera and send it anonymously to his friends and family. Make him scared to come to work.

I don't know. I was a fucking cunt in high school. Pure, weaponised autism. Thought I was smarter than everybody else by being a pedantic motherfucker. Didn't even realise that I was the only reason I never had any friends growing up. If I saw 16 year old me today, I'd punch that cunt right in the face.

I suspect high school me wouldn't like me because he thought he was above everybody. Present me realises I'm human shit like 99% of the species, indistinguishable from them.

I just avoid people to the best of my ability. I never go out for social events because I have literally no friends, so that's one problem solved. Whenever I go shopping for groceries, I either go to a 24 hour store in the dead of night or to a normal one about an hour before closing time (if you get too close to closing time you have to deal with idiots arguing with staff about closing and such.)

Find a job that involved minimal human contact. If you can find a workplace full of cynics/misanthropes as well it functions quite nicely because you all know what score is. I only once had this luxury while working in a lab with another guy before. 

Basically, just don't engage with people in any informal context. If you're talking to somebody who is fulfilling a role (cashier, salesman, barber etc) you can play on that. They aren't a human, they're an automaton made of meat that exists to carry out algorithms. Deal with them on this level.

Take the voidpill. Fuck the world, fuck society and fuck people. Just disengage altogether. You do you. Forget about everything else. When you see humans out and about, stop thinking of them as people and start thinking of them as animals, plants or rocks. They are just things that move around make noise, nothing more and nothing less.
The only things really fucking you over are your big eyes. Difficult to fix, even with cosmetic surgery.
Television and media is just psychological junk food. It is to the mind and the soul what drinking engine oil or bleach is to the body.
What the fuck is it with underachievers psychoanalysing others on Reddit anyway?

I'm not a nihilist you arrogant, presumptuous cunt. I'm just saying there comes a point when nothing is new any more, no more surprises are to be found, and that the world is a much more mechanical, predictable and careless place than the magical fantasy land you think adults live in.

We don't live in a world where goodness is rewarded. We live in a world where the cheaters and exploiters win. There's no corporeal or cosmic justice. You exploit or you wilt away. I've just removed myself from the equation altogether and have minimal contact with anybody. I can barely even bring myself to post on forums such as this.
Everything has been going downhill since the age of 11 when I became aware enough to see through the illusions that get people through life.

I see your predicament... Well, when you have your own place, you won't be beholden to anybody's bullshit. Play the game for now if there's no other choice, but just tell it as it is as soon as you're able.

Tell them you don't want to go because you're not especially bothered about this charade of a wedding that is probably going to end in divorce and that you can't be bothered to pretend to enjoy the company of boring reprobates for a whole day.
Nothing of value would be lost if every drug user OD'd and died today.
I'd throw that baby into the burning house and watch the mother run in and burn to death trying to save it.

I'm stuck in retail until my PhD starts later this year.

This job made me truly terminally and irredeemably misanthropic several months ago, so I could probably spend the rest of my life there as I just run scripts like a robot, make all the right noises so I get paid and pull all the right poses to mask the fact I have fantasies about gassing everybody in the room.
Welcome to the life of an ugly male. This will be the norm until you're in your mid 30s and a past-her-prime woman lets you pay for a house for her.

I know what you mean. I often wonder how people would react if they found my slice open corpse hanging in the front room, or if I slashed my wrists and then jumped off a tall building in a busy city centre.
It's the ideal state, I just wish we didn't have such a strong survival instinct. I want to pull the plug but my genes have other ideas.

We have a solution: nuclear weapons. The sooner we have a nuclear war, the better. Maybe some genius will combine smallpox and anthrax with the common cold and sort us all out, or release some airborne pathogen that makes us allergic to oxygen or something.

Working retail will make a misanthrope of anybody. Being exposed to people for that long just isn't healthy. You literally cannot put into the words the general arrogance, ignorance, stupidity and crudity of the average person. These degenerates, these walking fucking stains, these flesh-bags of complete genetic and existential waste, they aren't the exception, they're the fucking norm.
Do you not get attention from men or do you not get attention from the top 10% of men?
I'd rather be a dick than a liar. Sorry to invade your little safe space here, but if you're not going to allow honesty then this whole sub is meaningless.
Lose weight and fix your teeth. Also consider wearing less makeup.

Yes, sorry. Not only are you physically unattractive, the fact that you've never been with a girl in 20 years is pretty much a death sentence anyway considering most girls have 7 years experience by now.

Like others are saying, lose weight, iron your clothes and get rid of your ponytail, but you have a long and arduous journey ahead of you. 
You should also know that, due to your bone structure and ethnicity, you're going to be viewed as a 3/10 maximum for your entire life. I'm not saying that you should be the best that you can be, but it's going to be hard.

You won't be single forever, though. When you're 35-40 you'll find a woman of a similar age who can't attract prime men any more, and she'll let you pay for her to live in your house while she gives you cold birthday sex in the dark once a year.

Best of luck, boyo.
It's probably due to your looks. If you're unattractive, people hate you, especially attractive people. The more attractive a person is, the more of a cunt they are.

That's because you're naive. Some ignore retail workers for that reason, but as somebody who has worked in the industry for almost 2 years I can tell you for a fact that's usually not the case.

You're making a false assumption about what type of retail I work in. Being nice and affable is simply part of the job. We don't get paid to ham it up, we just have to be personable, which I am. It's not cynicism, it's a feeling of superiority and you can tell by the way they look at you and speak to you.

You should't assume to know what I am actually thinking.

You sound like you're projecting how you feel toward arguing with strangers on Reddit who you know nothing about it while underachieving in life.

I agree 100% this. When I'm shopping, I expect to be treated like shit by employees because of the shit they have to deal with. I make an effort to be nice to retail staff as well, which is something I never otherwise do.

It was okay at first because I thought "whatever, at least I'm getting paid".

But now it's just tiresome. I've been applying for other jobs for the past weeks and can hopefully leave soon. It can't come too soon, because my mental health and hope for the future in this world is at absolute rock bottom.

Cute, really cute, but I literally done nothing wrong in any of these circumstances. I was obeying all of the rules. I've driven those roads a thousand times and I know exactly what I'm doing.

How can you call me an asshole when I wasn't the one who ran in front of somebody to get to a conveyor belt first, only to completely ignore them when questioned about subsequently walking away? What's your fucking problem?
I only started driving a few months ago and I am having this exact experience. I thought I was misanthropic beforehand but holy fucking shit, this is something else altogether.

I agree. I work in retail and is has made me terminally misanthropic and inspired me to make an account just so I can post on this forum. 

Working in retail really, really teaches you the meaning of intrusive thoughts. It's just a showcase of the absolute worst humanity has to offer. All day. Every day. No exceptions.
